next.reason: 1985 VII.3.7.3 SR2: LINAGE 'Data-name-1, data-name-2, data-name-3, data-name-4 may be qualified.' The 2023 LINAGE syntax rules (§2023:13.18.34.3) neither restate nor forbid it; qualification is general: §2023:8.4.2.2.2 gives 'data-name-1 [ data-qualifier ] …', §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR1 requires it for non-unique names and §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR2 states 'A name may be qualified even though it does not need qualification'. Same meaning.
